_comment: Calibration phase 1: twin experiment on the 2° 90-day window from 1993-01 (frozen mixing and buoyancy gradients, upwind3 advection: bounded adjoint in all four start months, 1162458-1162461, while WENO bursts in April, July and October, LOGBOOK finding 20).
